FN-3PSIKEV-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 256
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Russell Bedsole
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 256 as introduced could decrease the obligations of the Department of Corrections
by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of any decrease in license plate
production costs due to the provisions of this bill.
